# Data

- DAT-004 (should): Migrations of a server database are applied by the deployment, with a migration bundle (or an idempotent SQL script, where someone must review the SQL first), before the new version takes traffic; an app never migrates a server database at startup outside local development. A database on the user's device, which no deployment reaches, is migrated by the app at startup with Migrate.
- DAT-014 (must): For automated deployment of EF Core migrations, use a migration bundle; use a SQL script instead when the SQL must be reviewed, modified, archived, or handed to a DBA before it is applied. Carefully consider before applying migrations at runtime in production; prefer a migration bundle for automation or a SQL script when review and approval are required, and don't make every application replica run migrations from its entrypoint. Use a separate identity for deployment that has permission to change the schema; the identity the application uses at run time should normally have only the permissions it needs to read and write data. Don't store production connection strings in source control or embed them in the bundle.
